cluster.title: Palette cluster
cluster.intro: Generates palettes that belong with the seed palette. Each one turns the seed around the colour wheel, so they read as one family with different identities.
cluster.seedHint: Select a saved palette in the library to use as the seed.
cluster.readOnlyHint: Press Modify to rename the cluster, drop palettes from it or plan new ones on the wheel.
cluster.noSeedInCluster: Keep at least one palette to plan new ones from it.

schemeHints.auto: Complementary for one, triad for two, square for three, then evenly spaced.
schemeHints.complementary: Opposite the seed. The strongest contrast.
schemeHints.splitComplementary: Either side of the opposite. Contrast with less tension.
schemeHints.triad: A third of the wheel apart. Balanced and lively.
schemeHints.square: A quarter of the wheel apart. Rich, needs one hue to lead.
schemeHints.analogous: Neighbours of the seed. Calm and closely related.
schemeHints.gaps: Placed in the widest free space between hues already in the cluster.

cluster.structureHint: Keep copies the seed colour by colour, so a monochromatic seed gives monochromatic palettes. A harmony builds each palette from its turned base colour.
cluster.balanceHint: Matches each colour to the lightness of the seed colour it came from, so no palette looks heavier than another.
